findings.text: _stored_review_key hashes a stored review's identity, plan versions, plan fingerprint, reviewed blob, status and section_digests, but not its findings or responses. A review record edited during a pass to answer a finding changes responses only, so the key is unchanged and the memoized dispatch-gate verdict for that section and exemption answer stays stale until the pass ends; the next pass recomputes, so the window is one admission pass.

The covering gate's command line runs ten test files, while 131 test files under tests/ import reckon.crew.queue_admission or reckon.crew.plan_review directly (156 mention them). The done-when asks that the importing test files add no failures against the base revision, so the zero-delta result is established on a subset; the manifest records the narrowing as a response to a nine-minute bound on the 155-file run.

The done-when asks the timing arm to record one pass's launch decisions 'before and after'; only the after arm is logged (first pass 4.195 s, mean 1.440 s over six requests), so the 1,250-2,980 s launch figure the plan cites is never measured through the same instrument at the base revision.
